hints.title: Prefix Product Division Strategy
hints.text: Cumulative product array allows computing any suffix product by dividing the total prefix product by an earlier prefix product.

hints.title: Zero Multiplication Reset
hints.text: Adding zero invalidates all prior products. Reset the prefix array whenever zero is encountered.

hints.title: Constant Time Evaluation Blueprint
hints.text: If k is greater than or equal to current prefix length, the window spans across a zero, so return 0. Otherwise return prefix[-1] // prefix[-1 - k].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Every operation executes in strict O(1) time using cumulative prefix multiplication.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Multiplying last k elements directly on every call takes O(K) time per query, timing out under 40,000 queries.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing running prefix products reduces suffix product to a single arithmetic division.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling of zeroes by resetting prefix array and O(1) division.

solutions.approach: Prefix Product Array with Zero Reset
